newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan CK Group buys 54,000T soybeans at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan CK Group buys 54,000T soybeans at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's CK group on Tuesday bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of Brazilian or Argentine soybeans from U.S. supplier Cargill at a tender, traders said.
The CK Group comprises Chia Hsin Flour Feed and Vegetable Oil Corp and some buyers from Taiwan's southern port city of Kaohsiung.
Both shipments at Tuesday's tender were fixed on a CNF basis, traders said.
